resources.string: Hex Preview uses the internet only to download its speech model (190 MB) and to check GitHub for updates. Your voice and words stay on this device.
Allow the microphone, then choose Hex Preview as your keyboard.
So Hex Preview can hear you
Choose Hex Preview in the list
Turn on Hex Preview in Settings
Allow the microphone in Hex Preview

Hex turns speech into text on this phone and never uploads your voice or what you type. It keeps no keystrokes or transcripts. To find updates, Hex Preview asks GitHub for its latest version when you open it and at most once a day from the keyboard. That request carries nothing about you or what you type, though GitHub sees your internet address, as with any website. Turn it off with Check for updates automatically.
Updating closes the keyboard for a moment. Tap a text field to bring it back.
You’re on mobile data. This download uses %1$s.
Android asks once whether Hex Preview may install its own updates. Turn on Allow from this source, then come back here.
The download stopped. Check your connection and try again.
GitHub didn’t answer as expected. Try again later.
There isn’t enough free space for the download.
The download didn’t match what was published, so nothing was installed.
The download wasn’t signed with Hex Preview’s key, so nothing was installed.
